title: Noncanonical integral-left comparisons obstruct transport normalization
statement: Fix all the geometric and coefficient data and an arbitrary TransportCoreData d as in [lem-sf-exceptional-ring-transport-core-data], and use the package TransportCoreNormalizationLaws of [lem-sf-exceptional-ring-transport-core-normalization-laws]. For every E, a normalization package for d forces d.integralLeft(E) to equal the unique comparison of [lem-sf-exceptional-integral-left-normalization-lift]. Consequently a noncanonical value at any E rules out such a package. More explicitly, let α be a nonidentity natural automorphism of the target functor finiteTorIntegralInclusion_X followed by sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor(c,E). Replace only d.integralLeft(E) by the canonical comparison followed by α, using a dependent function update. The resulting transport datum has no normalization package. In particular the existence of this α and d refutes the assertion that every transport datum has a normalization package. This statement is conditional on a nonidentity α and does not assert the existence of α for empty schemes or zero functors.

source.place: Construction 5.25 and Proposition 5.26; agent-expanded fully faithful lift and uniqueness argument for the specified proper/open realization.

proof.text: The first field of a normalization package is exactly the component equation of the canonical lift. Apply its uniqueness theorem to identify d.integralLeft(E) with that lift. An assumed inequality therefore contradicts any package.

After the single-field update, this equality says canonical ≪≫ α = canonical. Pass to hom natural transformations and cancel the canonical isomorphism to get α.hom = identity. Iso.ext gives α = Iso.refl, contradicting the hypothesis. A universal normalization assertion applied to this updated datum contradicts the just-proved obstruction.

theorem not_normalization_of_integralLeft_twist (E : FieldStage.{u} l)
    (α : (PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l E.carrier X ⋙
        sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k
          (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c E.carrier) ≅
      (PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l E.carrier X ⋙
        sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k
          (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c E.carrier))
    (hα : α ≠ Iso.refl _) :
    letI := Classical.decEq (FieldStage.{u} l)
    ¬ Nonempty (TransportCoreNormalizationLaws l Ω D hl c operation left
      { d with
        integralLeft := Function.update d.integralLeft E
          (normalizedIntegralLeft l Ω D hl c E
            (operation (.integral E)) (left (.integral E)) ≪≫ α) })
